ThingDef.label: Neoma repair kit
ThingDef.description: A sealed injector filled with Apex Crystal nano-repair agents. When administered, the agents propagate through the target's body and dissolve accumulated physical damage at the molecular level. Production requires Neoma's precise neural calibration — no one else can synthesize it.

ThingDef.label: Neoma cache purge kit
ThingDef.description: A pressurized canister that delivers a targeted electromagnetic discharge through the Synthera interface layer, instantly flushing accumulated system stress from the pawn's active cache. The purge is violent but harmless — Neoma describes it as "like a hard reboot, but you stay awake the whole time."
